items.text: Record plan for a guest-facing receipt engine
Read booking/payment code and any existing invoice or receipt code
Decide scope: receipt from stored booking data, no VAT claim until the accountant answers
Build the server side: receipt data assembled from a booking, plus an endpoint
Rebuild the PDF so it reads from the server payload and follows the chosen language
Verify: lint, frontend build, server type-check, tests, real row, real browser render
Update the compliance document and commit
